definitions.explanation: a ceramic cooking pot made of clay, traditionally used for one-pot dishes

examples.japanese: {土鍋|どなべ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{鍋料理|なべりょうり}→鍋料理：19952_naberyouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Make a hot pot dish in an earthenware pot.
Cook rice in a clay pot.
Clay pots are used a lot in winter.

notes:
{土鍋|どなべ} is a traditional Japanese clay pot for one-pot cooking and rice ({土|ど} earth/clay + ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧ pot). It retains and distributes heat well and keeps food warm at the table, but is fragile and cracks under sudden temperature change.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {土鍋|どなべ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{鍋料理|なべりょうり}→鍋料理：19952_naberyouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make a hot pot dish in a clay pot
- {土鍋|どなべ}ご{飯|はん}: rice cooked in a clay pot

WATCH OUT: Never heat a {土鍋|どなべ} empty, and let it cool gradually — thermal shock can crack it.

SIMILAR WORDS: Strongly associated with winter and ⟦{鍋|なべ}→鍋：01038_nabe⟧ (hot pot) season, unlike everyday metal pots such as ⟦{鉄鍋|てつなべ}→鉄鍋：23918_tetsunabe⟧ or ⟦{片手鍋|かたてなべ}→片手鍋：28930_katatenabe⟧.

REGISTER: Neutral; common in cooking and daily life.
